purpose: Define how null comparisons must be selected before any candidate-vs-null scoring is interpreted.
null_selection_rules: Null artifacts must not be selected because they already look dissimilar to the candidate.
Null artifacts must be drawn from the same broad registry epoch and comparable artifact class where possible.
For clock cases, nulls must also contain clock/time tokens so that mere presence of a timestamp is not treated as signal.
For mythopoetic cases, nulls must have comparable religious/cultural vocabulary density so that shared vocabulary is not treated as hidden structure.
For technical timing cases, nulls must include ordinary scheduler/Git/automation timing logs with both delays and timestamp bookkeeping where available.
Versions and mirrors of the same root may never occupy separate null slots.
Generated indexes and prior Connection/Not-Prediction scans may not be used as independent null roots.
Null labels are frozen before candidate scoring.

planned_metrics.definition: Whether a blinded reviewer can recover a nontrivial relation from the neutral packet without prior JANUS labels.
How much of the apparent recurrence remains after derivative presentations are collapsed to source roots.
Whether the relation remains after project-native threshold/dual/home/return vocabulary is neutralized.
Candidate structural-match rate minus matched-null structural-match rate under the same reviewer/scorer.

minimum_interpretation_boundary.even_if_structural_excess_survives: The result would establish only that a structural pattern is less common in matched nulls under the frozen scoring procedure.
